meta.description: WSK-29 (docs/plans/2026-08-26-webdesk-PROGRESS.md's own line for this ticket; design docs/blueprints/webdesk-design.md ll.580/748/933 + docs/blueprints/webdev-design.md l.693 — 'wd-contract-watch NEW'). Job: when a WebDesk (Zone B) tenant publishes a new /v1 contract snapshot (kind='contract.published', already accepted end-to-end by WSK-12's bridge -> webdev_zoneb_event_log -- see wd-zoneb-intake.json's own KINDS list, unmodified by this ticket), surface a 'site pinned older contract' console notice per AFFECTED SITE (one still pinned to an earlier snapshotId). NEVER auto-upgrades a site's pin (webdev D-5) -- this flow only notifies. Read -> notify, no logic of its own, same shape wd-stale-nag.json already uses. Scoped identity wf:wd-contract-watch -> [webdev.listPendingContractNotices, notify]. Env: HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, WD_CONTRACT_WATCH_ENABLED. GATED like wd-zoneb-intake.json's own INGEST_ENABLED doctrine: inert until WD_CONTRACT_WATCH_ENABLED=1 AND the read tool this flow calls actually exists -- see the Gate node's own comment. HONEST STATUS (recorded by WSK-29, 2026-08-27): PROTOTYPED, NOT live. `webdev.listPendingContractNotices` does not exist anywhere in this repo today -- registering it is a platform-nest (webdev module) change outside WSK-29's file ownership (.github/workflows/, mcp-hub/, webdesk/deploy/), reported rather than built. The CONTRACT this flow expects from that tool is documented in the 'MCP webdev.listPendingContractNotices' node's own `notes` field so whoever builds it has a concrete shape to build against.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "webdev.listPendingContractNotices", arguments: {} } }) }}

nodes.notes: WSK-29 — the CONTRACT this NOT-YET-BUILT read tool must satisfy: given the calling principal's reach (no arguments needed — the platform resolves tenant scope from the OBO envelope, same as every other hub-aggregated read), return one row per WebDesk site CURRENTLY PINNED OLDER than the latest contract.published snapshot recorded for its tenant/slug (webdev_contract_snapshots, WSK-19): { tenantId, siteId, siteSlug, pinnedSnapshotId, latestSnapshotId, recipientId }. `recipientId` may be null/absent (no owner resolved yet) — the next node still processes the row and simply raises no notification for it, the same 'fact lands, notice is best-effort' doctrine wd-zoneb-intake.json already uses for form.received. Registering this as a platform-nest `webdev` module `mcpTools` GET entry (impact: none — it's a read) is outside WSK-29's file ownership; reported, not built.
